claims.text: Complex I couples NADH-to-ubiquinone electron transfer to a proton gradient supporting ATP synthesis.
Calculations identify inter-cluster electron tunnelling paths and predict enhanced transfer when internal water is included.

references.locator: Abstract; Results and Discussion: Enhancement of Electron Transfer Rates due to the Internal Water

limits: Computed pathways and enhancements are not direct observations of individual electrons.
Exact parameters and model equations have not been extracted.

claims.text: Pulsed-field exposure increased ROS in the tested mammalian cell cultures; cryptochrome-deficient cultures lacked the reported response.
limits: Restricted to the tested preparations and exposure conditions.
Exact field waveform, timing and assay parameters await structured extraction.

claims.text: Spin-dependent radical-pair chemistry is proposed as an explanation for the magnetic response.
limits: The cellular experiments do not directly resolve the proposed spin mechanism.
Alternative cryptochrome-dependent mechanisms are not excluded.

claims.text: Low-power laser treatment induced ROS and activated latent TGF-β1; the study reports dental stem-cell differentiation and animal dentin regeneration.
limits: Preclinical findings; clinical efficacy in humans is not established by this record.
The abstract does not establish a distinctive tunnelling, spin or coherence mechanism.

claims.text: Chiral Pt has a higher ORR onset potential than the tested racemic-derived Pt comparator.
CISS-mediated spin filtering is proposed to enhance ORR.
limits: Mechanism attribution is distinct from the electrochemical observation.

claims.text: Spin-state selection and stabilization yield a modelled rate enhancement.
limits: Illustrative model; not an observed biological rate.

claims.text: The cysteine-coated Au comparison reports a positive onset-potential shift.
